intervals.quote: New precise results of a measurement of the elastic electron-proton scattering cross section performed at the Mainz Microtron MAMI are presented.

website.quote: These experiments aim in particular to study the spatial structure of atomic nuclei or nuclear building blocks.

summary.plain: The Mainz collaboration, led by Harald Merkel, that runs the three-spectrometer electron-scattering facility A1 at MAMI.
summary.technical: A1 Collaboration (Institut für Kernphysik, JGU Mainz); 19 members listed for 2017 on the A1 website; spokesperson Harald Merkel.
